capabilities: Export the vault graph to Mermaid and GraphViz dot formats
Choose a focus mode (single parent or full graph)
Choose a relationship strategy (tags, links, folders)
Write exported graph files into the vault
extras: README notes Mermaid's limited scale makes it suited to smaller graphs and recommends .dot for bigger snapshots.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Graph View is great, but not everyone has Obsidian installed on their machine.
motivation: The author built it because not everyone has Obsidian installed and users sometimes need to carry a snapshot to show ideas to friends and colleagues.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is only viewable inside the app, so users cannot share or open a snapshot of their vault graph in other tools.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's built-in Graph View is great, but not everyone has Obsidian installed on their machine.

summary: Graph export plugin that converts the vault's graph view into Mermaid (.mmd) or GraphViz (.dot) files.
